# ADR-3090: A08: CDN integrity skip for script include 6

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Missing SRI allows CDN compromise impact.

## Decision

Pages SHALL NOT use a CDN integrity skip for script include 6 (A08-6) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Subresource Integrity hashes are mandatory.
